items.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
items.description: The US president says he is holding off on a US attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

items.title: Teen suspects fatally shoot three in suspected hate crime at San Diego mosque
items.description: The alleged attackers were aged 17 and 18 and one left a note containing "generalised hate rhetoric", investigators say.

items.title: At least 131 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, official says
items.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared the outbreak an international emergency.

items.title: Selling children to survive: Afghan fathers forced to make impossible choices
items.description: In Afghanistan today, a staggering three in four people cannot meet their basic needs.

items.title: The Republican who stood up to Trump is hoping for a big win against president
items.description: The Kentucky congressman, who has crossed the president on federal spending and the Epstein files, faces Republican voters on Tuesday.

items.title: Two dead in Spain shooting, with babies reportedly among injured
items.description: Police say a 25-year-old man is suspected of killing his parents and injuring four others in southern Spain.

items.title: What really holds China and Russia together
items.description: The relationship endures despite a power imbalance, with both sides recognising that it is too important to fail.

items.title: Tasmanian government apologises over stolen body parts scandal
items.description: An investigation found that 177 human specimens from dozens of bodies were secretly kept by a museum.

items.title: Starbucks Korea sacks CEO over controversial 'Tank Day' promotion
items.description: Starbucks withdrew the campaign for its drink tumblers after many said it referenced a bloody crackdown.

items.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
items.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

items.title: Trump administration unveils $1.7bn fund to compensate his allies as he drops tax lawsuit
items.description: The settlement will go towards individuals who allege they were subjected to unfair investigations.

items.title: Two men arrested over stunt at enclosure of famous monkey Punch
items.description: Two US nationals have been arrested after one jumped the fence of the monkey, who went viral online, police say.
